column1: # How-to category rules (owner 2026-10-12). Read by categories.py; tested by tests/unit/test-search-howto.sh.
#   verdict  allow!  an exception that wins over every deny row (the trivial car jobs the owner named)
#            deny    never generated, never routed — the card stays off
#            health  never generated; routed to the MedlinePlus topic (public domain)
#            allow   may be generated (grounded first; ungrounded only in cooking/crafts/household/software)
#   pattern  words matched as a contiguous run of STEMS inside the topic key (topics.key), so plural, -ing
#            and -ed forms match; a one-word pattern matches that stem anywhere.
# Precedence: allow! > deny > health > allow > (no match = unknown: not generated until the kinds model
# or a person files it). Keep deny rows broad and allow rows narrow — a wrong allow ships a wrong card.
# --- exceptions: the trivial car jobs (jump-start, change a tyre) are IN; brakes, airbags, fuel are OUT
# --- deny: medical procedures and drugs (a MedlinePlus topic is not an answer to these either)
# --- deny: anything with a licence or permit, and the dangerous trades
# --- health: routed to the MedlinePlus topic, never generated
